_comment: Sign classes (sign_id) and their Kannada text. The recognizer can only output labels that you have recorded and trained. '_none' is a background/transition class that is never added to the transcript. Kannada strings are standard Kannada words; HOW each sign is performed must be taken from a verified ISL reference (e.g. the ISLRTC Indian Sign Language dictionary) - this file does not define the signs themselves.
